title: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.21183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.

translated_title: 看见不等于解决：基于会话锚定的视觉与语言消歧
translated_abstract: 现有的视觉锚定基准通常未考虑真实场景中的上下文不确定性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个新颖的基准——JAG-D（基于对话的歧义视觉锚定日语评测）数据集。该数据集由人机对话式多模态交互构成，涵盖了源于视觉和语言两类不同类型的歧义。我们评估了多种最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在歧义识别与消解方面的能力，并比较了它们在解决视觉歧义与语言歧义时的对话上下文锚定性能。实验结果表明，视觉语言模型能够通过利用对话上下文显著提升语言歧义（尤其是日语零指代）的消解能力。我们进一步开展了对比分析，以探究锚定性能的提升究竟源于对话的语义内容，还是其会话结构。
tldr: 本文构建了含人机对话歧义场景的日语视觉锚定基准JAG-D，发现视觉语言模型能借助对话上下文显著提升语言歧义（尤其是日语零指代）的消解能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JAG-D, a Japanese benchmark for ambiguity-aware visual grounding in human-robot dialogue, showing that VLMs substantially improve linguistic ambiguity resolution (especially Japanese zero anaphora) by leveraging conversational context.
